name: Subic Bay Freeport Zone 32KM Challenge 2026
short_description: A multi-distance road race in Subic Bay Freeport Zone, Philippines, featuring 32KM, 21.1KM, 10KM, and 5KM options on August 16, 2026.
ai_summary: The Subic Bay Freeport Zone 32KM Challenge 2026 is a multi-distance road race organized by JCIR Events, scheduled for August 16, 2026. Runners can choose from 32KM, 21.1KM (half-marathon), 10KM, or 5KM distances, with the primary distance being the half-marathon. The race is based at the Boardwalk in Subic, within the Subic Bay Freeport Zone / Olongapo area of the Philippines. Registration details have not yet been announced.
